thread:
isabel: Heads-up from a manager: they submitted a mid-cycle leveling (L3->L4) with a comp adjustment, but forgot to attach peer feedback and director ack. Payroll cutover is Thurs. What do we do?

derek_mgr: quick triage: if docs missing at cutover we'll hold. Can manager upload within 48h? If yes, we can try an expedited review.

hannah_comp: policy note: mid-cycle level changes with comp moves >5% require 2 reviewers and comp partner ok. Missing evidence means no fast-track.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Promotion policy v3.2: evidence bundle (manager justification, peer feedback, reviewer sign-offs) must be in People Ops drive and linked in Workday before payroll cutoff to avoid holds.

isabel: manager says they can gather feedback in 24h but director is on travel and slow to reply. Any workaround for director ack?

derek_mgr: director ack can be an email or Slack thread from the director. If they're traveling, ask for an explicit quick Slack approval and paste into the intake. That counts.

ana_payroll: FYI payroll needs the final Workday case before cutover to schedule changes. If case completes but evidence is late, payroll still holds until People Ops confirms.

hannah_comp: operational suggestion: manager should upload a "pending" evidence file with links to raw feedback and note "director approving via slack thread X" so we can triage. But we still require actual sign-off before final approval.

isabel: OK I'll tell them to upload a placeholder with links. Two practical asks: 1) can we allow one-time exception to bypass second reviewer if director confirms? 2) what's the messaging to employee if we hold?

hannah_comp: 1) No, second reviewer rule stands for comp increases >5% to ensure calibration. Exceptions only via exec sponsor email to people-ops + comp partner for expedited review. 2) Messaging: short, factual. Example: "We're finalizing your role change. We are waiting for a required approval and will complete the administrative update in the next payroll cycle. Any retro pay will be processed after approvals."

people-ops-bot: Action created: /task create "Add placeholder-evidence guideline + sample Slack director ack template" assigned to isabel, due 2026-06-01.

derek_mgr: one more edge-case: manager accidentally selected "title-only" in Workday but included comp in justification. How do we correct without delaying?

hannah_comp: correct the Workday request to "comp change" and update the intake with comp details. That will trigger the comp partner review. If the payroll cutoff is close, expect a hold unless all reviewers sign quickly.

isabel: manager asks if comp partners can pre-approve estimated numbers to speed things up?

hannah_comp: we can provide a provisional sign-off for budgeting but final approval must include documented evidence. Provisional approvals should be tagged "budget-only" and not be used to bypass reviewers.

ana_payroll: operational note: retro pay for mid-cycle promos typically processes in 1-2 cycles after approvals. Large batches may add a cycle. Tell managers to set expectations.

isabel: can someone draft a 2-line template I can paste to the employee if we hit a hold? Keep it neutral.

hannah_comp: draft: "Quick update: your role change is approved but pending final documentation. Payroll will apply the update in the next pay cycle after approvals; any retro pay will be processed then. We'll update you once complete."

isabel: perfect. Thanks all. Closing once I upload the placeholder guideline. :white_check_mark:
